evidence.quote: Pauline Stuart Partner and Marketing Director Pauline joined Trinity Street in 2013 and is based in the London office. She was made Partner in 2014. Prior to Trinity Street, she was an Executive Director at BNY Mellon. She also previously worked at JP Morgan, Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, Citibank and Merrill Lynch as well as spending some time in the charity sector. Pauline holds a BA in Languages from Heriot-Watt University.
